title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 7.52
exact_target: Characterise compact sets in several complex variables whose polynomial algebra has Šilov boundary equal to the entire topological boundary of the polynomial hull.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2307052 (AMR-022-7052). CC BY4.0.
